notes: Portable model-identification modification-date presentation through official Federation Create and object-class lookup services. The adapter supplies provider package, standard MIM, two schema-valid FOM bindings, endpoint, logical time, and callback model. A timezone-suffixed xs:date is rejected, while the same model with YYYY-MM-DD is accepted. One focused packaged Umbra JNI Java parity runtime run passed (out/java-tck/model-modification-date-jni-20261021.json); other Java providers, omitted modification dates, private diagnostics, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
